book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Mataayo

content: Yɨɨsu aragambɨra ʉkʉsaribhwa kwa rihekaaru
Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉka mwihekaaru. Hanʉ aarɨ arahʉrʉkamu, abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakamutuna korereke bhamwereche chɨmbu amakindasi ga rihekaaru gazʉmirɨ.
Nawe Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Mʉrʉʉzɨ bhwaheene amakindasi ganʉ gʉʉsi? Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, rɨtareeho ibhwɨ rɨnʉ rɨkʉsaaga igʉrʉ wɨ ɨrɨndɨ!”
Yɨɨsu aragambɨra ɨnyaakʉ yɨnʉ ikuuza

Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akaja kʉkɨgʉrʉ chɨ Ɨmɨzɨyituuni akiikara. Abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakamutuna kekoro, bhakamubhuurya, “Tʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ, amangʼana gayo garahʉrʉka ryʉrɨ? Na ni‑chɨrɨkɨnʼyʉkɨ kɨnʉ kiriitwereche ʉkʉgarʉka kwazʉ nu ukuhika mʉtɨnɨrʉ wɨ ɨɨsɨ?”
Yɨɨsu akabhagarukirya, “Mwangarɨrɨ, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi ataaza kʉbhakangirirya!
Abhaatʉ bhaaru bharaaza kuriina ryanɨ, bharabhuga, ‘Inyɨ ni‑Kiriisitʉ,’ na bharakangirirya abhaatʉ bhaaru.
“Ribhaga riyo, mʉrabha muriigwa igʉrʉ wa riihɨ na amangʼana ga riihɨ. Mʉtakangwa, kʉ kʉbha gayo gareenderwa gakorwe, nawe ɨtɨnɨrʉ yɨ ɨɨsɨ ɨrabha ɨkɨɨrɨ.
Icharʉ kɨmwɨ kiriitana nɨ ɨkɨndɨ, nʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhʉmwɨ bhuriitana nʉ ʉbhʉndɨ. Ɨnzara ni ibhirigitʉ bhyɨ ɨɨsɨ bhɨrahʉrʉka ahagero hʉʉsi.
Gayo gʉʉsi garabha chɨmbu ʉbhʉtangɨ bhwʉ ʉbhʉsʉngʉ bhwʉ ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ akwenda kwibhʉra.
Ribhaga riyo, abhaatʉ bharabhiichʉra korereke mʉnyaakɨ na kubhiita, na abhaatʉ bhi ibhyarʉ bhyʉsi bharabhabhiihirirwa igʉrʉ waanɨ.
Neho abhaatʉ bhaaru bharatiga kuntuna. Bharabha bhariiyanga na kwiyigatanɨra abheene kobheene.
“Na bharabhoneka abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhaaru bhʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ, bhanʉ bharaakangiriryɨ abhaatʉ bhaaru.
Nʉ ʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwa abhaatʉ bhaaru bhʉrasuuha, kʉ kʉbha ʉbhʉbhɨ bhʉraaruha.
Nawe wʉnʉ ariigumiriryɨ kuhika ɨtɨnɨrʉ, newe araasabhʉkɨ.

Ɨtɨnɨrʉ, Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ bhɨrarwazibhwa mʉzɨɨsɨ zʉʉsi. Kwa ribhaga rɨnʉ abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bharabha bhabhwɨnɨ umweya gu ukwigwa ʉbhʉmɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhuyo, neho ɨtɨnɨrʉ yɨ ɨɨsɨ ɨrahika.
Zisikʉ zɨ ɨnyaakʉ ɨkʉrʉ mucharʉ cha Yudeya
“Ribhaga riyo, mʉrarora ʉbhʉrʉrʉ bhʉnʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri Danyɨri aabhugirɨ ʉbhʉsarya. Mʉrarora bhwimiiriirɨ Ahagero Aharɨndu ha rihekaaru.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akosoma amangʼana ganʉ, amenye enzobhooro yaku.
Neho abhaatʉ bhanʉ bharɨ Yudeya, bhangʼosere mʉbhɨgʉrʉ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ari igʉrʉ kʉkɨsara chi inyumba, atiika korereke agege ebhegero bhɨnʉ bhiri munyumba, angʼose.
Na wʉnʉ akʉbha mʉmʉgʉndʉ angʼose, atiichʉra inyuma kogega zengebho zaazɨ.
Tʉrabharorera ɨbhɨgʉngi abhakari bhanʉ bharɨnda na bhanʉ bhakʉbha bharakoocha zisikʉ ziyo.
Mmbe, mʉsabhɨ Mungu kʉbha kuryara kwanyu kʉtaaza kʉbha ribhaga rye embeho ɨhaari hamwɨ kurusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ.
Maheene, zisikʉ ziyo, abhaatʉ bharabhona ɨnyaakʉ kʉrʉ bhʉkʉngʼu. Ɨnyaakʉ yɨnʉ, ɨkɨɨrɨ kʉhʉrʉka kwɨma ʉbhʉtangɨ bhwɨ ɨɨsɨ kuhika reero yɨnʉ. Na ɨtakobhoneka kwikɨ yɨndɨ.
Angabhɨɨrɨ Mungu atasuuhya zisikʉ ziyo, ataarɨ areho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ aarɨ akʉsabhʉka. Nawe arasuuhya zisikʉ ziyo, igʉrʉ wa abharobhorwa bhaazɨ.
“Mmbe, ribhaga riyo, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi araabhabhʉʉrɨrɨ, ‘Rora, Kiriisitʉ arɨ hanʉ!’ hamwɨ, ‘Ari irya!’ mutiisirirya.

Bharabhaho abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ na abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakwibhɨrɨkɨra Kiriisitʉ. Bhareerekenʼya ibhyɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ bhyaru na amateemo korereke bhageme kurimirya abhaatʉ, ɨrɨɨtʉrɨkanɨ nʉʉrʉ abharobhorwa bha Mungu.
Mʉbhɨ mɨɨsʉ! Nɨbhabhuuriirɨ bhwangʉ gʉʉsi gayo gakɨɨrɨ kʉhʉrʉka.
Mmbe abhaatʉ bharaabhabhʉʉrɨrɨ, ‘Rora, Kiriisitʉ ari mwitɨrɨgʉ irya!’ mʉtajayu. Hamwɨ bharaabhabhʉʉrɨrɨ, ‘Rora, yiibhisirɨ munyumba muyo!’ mʉtaaza kubhiisirirya.
Momenye kʉbha ukuuza ku Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ, kʉrabha kwa kʉtacha. Ɨrabha chɨmbu ʉrʉkʉbha rʉhaarorekana rogendo rʉmwɨ rʉgʉrʉ na nyanza.
Ahagero hɨ ɨkɨtʉndʉ, neho zɨmatʉʉnyi zikwibhiringa.
Yɨɨsu aragambɨra ʉkʉgarʉka kwazɨ

“Mmbe, hanʉ ɨnyaakʉ ya ribhaga riyo ɨraahɨtɨbhu, iryʉbha rɨrabha ni ikiirimya, umwɨri gʉtakuhurucha ubhwɨrʉ naatu, na zenzota zʉʉsi zɨragwa haasɨ kurwa mwisaarʉ. Ebhegero bhyʉsi bhya mwisaarʉ bhɨrasingisa.
“Neho, ichɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ chu Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ kɨraarorekanɨ mwisaarʉ, ni ibhyarʉ bhyʉsi bhɨratanga kʉrɨra kubhwʉbha. Hanʉ nikuuza, abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bharandora mʉmasaarʉ na zinguru nʉ ʉbhʉkʉrʉ.

Neho aratʉma bhamaraika bhaazɨ. Bharatema rihembe bhʉkʉngʼu, korereke bhabhiringɨ abharobhorwa bhʉʉsi bha Mungu kurwa mbaara zʉʉsi inyɨ zɨ ɨɨsɨ. Nabhʉ bharaaza kurwa mʉtɨnɨrʉ yʉ ʉrʉbhaara rʉmwɨ rwɨ ɨɨsɨ kuhika mʉtɨnɨrʉ yʉ ʉrʉbhaara ʉrʉndɨ.”
Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Mwɨgɨ kurwa kʉmʉtɨ gwu umutiini. Hanʉ mokorora ibhisha bhɨrasɨbhʉka na amatʉʉtʉ gabhariryɨ, mʉramenya kʉbha ribhaga rya rigesa rɨrariirɨ.
Ɨbhuɨbhu, hanʉ mʉraarore gayo gʉʉsi gatangirɨ, momenye kʉbha arɨ haguhɨ kuuza.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ribhaga ryu urwibhʉrʉ rʉnʉ rɨtakʉhɨta kuhika gayo gʉʉsi gakorwe.
Risaarʉ nɨ ɨɨsɨ bhɨrahɨta, nawe ɨngʼana yaanɨ ɨtakʉhɨta kemerano.
“Nawe, igʉrʉ wu urusikʉ na ribhaga ryu ukuuza, atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ yɨɨzɨ. Naabha bhamaraika bha mwisaarʉ hamwɨ Umwana bhʉʉsi bhatɨɨzɨ, nawe Bhaabha umwenebhu.
Kuriyo, ukuuza ku Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ kʉrabha chɨmbu yaarɨ zisikʉ za Nuuhu.
Ribhaga rɨnʉ imbura ya riteemo yaarɨ ɨkɨɨrɨ kuuza, abhaatʉ bhaarɨ bhararya na kunywa, bharakwɨra na kukwɨrwa, kuhika urusikʉ rʉnʉ Nuuhu aasikiirɨ mʉsafina.
Abhaatʉ bhayo bhataamɨnyirɨ nɨkɨ kɨkʉbha, kuhika hanʉ riteemo rya amanzi ryizirɨ na kubhiita bhʉʉsi. Ɨbhu nɨmbu ɨrɨɨbhɨ hanʉ Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ ariizɨ.
Ribhaga riyo, abhaatʉ bhabhɨrɨ bharɨɨbhɨ mʉmʉgʉndʉ, Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ aragegaho ʉwʉmwɨ na kutiga ʉwʉndɨ.
Na abhakari bhabhɨrɨ arɨɨbhɨ bharasha hamwɨmwɨ kʉrʉbhwɨ, Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ aragegaho ʉwʉmwɨ na kutiga ʉwʉndɨ.
Mmbe motengeeze, kʉ kʉbha mʉtɨɨzɨ ni‑rusikʉkɨ rʉnʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ waanyu ariizɨ.
“Nawe momenye bhwaheene ringʼana rɨnʉ, wi inyumba angamɨnyirɨ ribhaga rɨnʉ umwibhi akuuza, aarɨ aratengeeza, na ataarɨ arahindɨra korereke umwibhi ataaza kohomora inyumba na kwibha.
Nangʉ, na niimwɨ mʉbhɨ bhwaheene ibhaga ryʉsi, kʉ kʉbha Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ araaza ribhaga rɨnʉ mʉtakwisega.”
Ekerenjo cha mbʉʉsa omoheene

Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya abhɨɨga bhaazɨ, “Mmbe, nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ mbʉʉsa omoheene na wa amangʼɨɨni? Nɨ‑mbʉʉsa wʉnʉ ʉmʉkʉrʉ waazɨ amʉtɨɨrɨ kʉbha umwimiiririri wa bhambʉʉsa abhandɨ munyumba yaazɨ, korereke abhɨ arabhaha ibhyakurya kwibhaga ryazɨ.
Hakɨrɨku mbʉʉsa wʉnʉ hanʉ ʉmʉkʉrʉ waazɨ araagarʉkɨ kurwa orogendo arabhona arakora chɨmbu aamuswajiryɨ.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ʉmʉkʉrʉ waazɨ aratʉʉra omohocha wuyo abhɨ umwimiiririri we ebhegero bhyazɨ bhyʉsi.
“Nawe mbʉʉsa ʉmʉbhɨ nɨ‑wʉnʉ ahiigambɨra mokoro yaazɨ, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ waanɨ arakeezera kʉgarʉka,’
ahaatanga kotema bhambʉʉsa abhakɨndichazɨ, na kurya na kunywa amarwa hamwɨmwɨ na abhanywi.
Ʉmʉkʉrʉ waazɨ aragarʉka urusikʉ nɨ ɨɨsa yɨnʉ mbʉʉsa atakwiseega.
Aramotema kɨbhɨ na kʉmʉtʉʉra iribhita imwɨmwɨ na abhabhɨɨhi. Iyo bhararɨra na kokepeha.”
